name: Knee to chest
movement: lying on the back, one knee hugged to the chest and held, the other leg flat

phone.placement: Lay the phone on its side on the floor, two or three metres away, side on to you.

words.hint: Lying on your back, one knee hugged in to the chest and held, the other leg flat.
words.start: Lay the phone on its side on the floor. Lie on your back side on to it and hug one knee in to your chest.
words.position: Lie on your back side on to the phone, the working leg nearest it. Hug that knee in toward the chest with both hands behind the thigh; the other leg stays flat on the floor.
words.top: The knee drawn in close to the chest, the other leg flat and straight, the head and shoulders down, held.
howto: Lie on your back, both legs straight.
Bring one knee up and hug it in toward the chest with both hands behind the thigh, until a stretch is felt in the lower back and the buttock.
Hold for the count, breathing, with the other leg flat on the floor and the head down.
Lower the leg slowly, then the other side.
words.cannot: How the lower back feels and whether the shoulders are relaxed: it sees how close the knee is and whether the other leg stays down.
words.about: Knee to chest — lying on the back side on: the hug, as the angle at the hip between the shoulder and the knee, at most 60° (the knee drawn in close; the leg flat is 180); and the other leg flat, its knee at least 160°. The clock runs while both are right. Thirty seconds a hold, three holds each side.
words.lost: Lie on your back side on to the camera, the whole body in
words.hold: That is it — hold and breathe
words.safety: A stretch, not a strain: hold behind the thigh, not over the kneecap. Stop if the pain travels down the leg.
words.easier: The other knee bent with the foot flat; a shorter hold; less pull.
words.harder: A longer hold; the knee drawn a little closer; both knees together.
words.mistakes: The other leg lifting or bending; pulling on the shin or kneecap; lifting the head; holding the breath.

measurements.label: knee to chest
measurements.why: The angle at the hip between the shoulder and the knee: 180 with the leg flat, under 60 with the knee hugged in close.

settings.label: Hip angle with the knee hugged in, at most

measurements.label: other leg straight
